mechanism: Both drugs can reduce renal function and increase serum creatinine; ceftazidime is nephrotoxic and irbesartan reduces glomerular filtration rate, potentially leading to additive renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) before and during concurrent use; adjust ceftazidime dosing based on renal function; assess hydration status and consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment develops.
